Name: PlantVillage
Role_in_HOPPER: Reference lab-controlled image dataset used across the plant disease computer-vision literature.
Notes: Widely used benchmark; images are uniform-background and lab-controlled, which limits field generalizability.

Reference_Publication.Title: An open access repository of images on plant health to enable the development of mobile disease diagnostics through machine learning and crowdsourcing

Name: PlantDoc
Role_in_HOPPER: Field-condition image dataset built to address PlantVillage's lab-only bias.
Notes: Internet-sourced and cropped images; comparatively small scale.

Reference_Publication.Title: PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection
Reference_Publication.Authors: Singh, D., Jain, N., Jain, P., Kayal, P., Kumawat, S. & Batra, N.

Name: CCMT Dataset
Role_in_HOPPER: Field-condition West African image dataset spanning four crops.
Notes: Canonical stable dataset URL not independently verified for this prototype; represented via literature reference only.

Name: FieldPlant
Role_in_HOPPER: Plantation-collected image dataset annotated under plant-pathologist supervision.
Notes: Linked via its IEEE Access publication DOI rather than a dataset-hosting URL.

Name: Cassava Leaf Disease Dataset
Role_in_HOPPER: Crowdsourced regional dataset structured for direct ML pipeline integration.
Notes: Distributed as a Kaggle competition dataset; narrow single-crop focus.

Name: PlantPAD
Role_in_HOPPER: Large-scale, literature-aggregated image phenomics platform with pre-trained diagnostic models.
Notes: Breadth introduces annotation inconsistency inherited from heterogeneous source literature.

Name: IP102
Role_in_HOPPER: Large-scale insect pest recognition benchmark with hierarchical taxonomy.
Notes: Natural long-tailed class distribution; common-name labelling introduces taxonomic imprecision.

Reference_Publication.Title: IP102: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Insect Pest Recognition
Reference_Publication.Authors: Wu, X., Zhan, C., Lai, Y-K., Cheng, M-M. & Yang, J.

Name: FungiDB
Role_in_HOPPER: Principal aggregator for fungal/oomycete pathogen genomics; part of the VEuPathDB federation.
Notes: Consolidates previously fragmented single-species genome browsers into one comparative platform.

Reference_Publication.Title: FungiDB: an integrated functional genomics database for fungi
Reference_Publication.Authors: Stajich, J.E., Harris, T., Brunk, B.P. et al.

Name: DPVweb
Organisms_Crops: Plant, fungal and protozoal viruses, viroids, satellites
Role_in_HOPPER: Long-standing reference for plant virus taxonomy and genome organization.
Notes: Genome/taxonomy layer only; does not cover host-response or silencing data.

Name: PVsiRNAdb
Role_in_HOPPER: Catalogues plant virus-derived siRNAs involved in RNA-silencing defense suppression.
Access: Access intermittent (reported unreachable at last check)
Notes: Database Commons reported this resource as unaccessible at time of last check; retained here as a resource-level reference only.

Name: PHI-base
Organisms_Crops: Fungal, oomycete, bacterial and viral pathogens across plant, animal and fungal hosts
Role_in_HOPPER: Central, actively maintained host-pathogen interaction aggregator; part of the ELIXIR UK node.
Notes: Manual literature curation means a lag between new findings and structured records.

Reference_Publication.Title: PHI-base: the multi-species Pathogen-Host Interaction Database in 2025
Reference_Publication.Authors: Urban, M., Cuzick, A., Seager, J. et al.

Name: PlaD
Organisms_Crops: Plant hosts under documented pathogen challenge
Role_in_HOPPER: Extends interaction curation into the host expression domain.
Notes: Cross-referencing to PHI-base interaction records still requires manual reconciliation.

Name: PRGdb
Role_in_HOPPER: Catalogues resistance gene analogs and predicted NBS-LRR immune receptor families.
Notes: Domain/model-based prediction over-predicts functional resistance genes relative to experimentally confirmed sets.

Reference_Publication.Title: PRGdb 4.0: an updated database dedicated to genes involved in plant disease resistance process
Reference_Publication.Authors: Calle García, J., Guadagno, A., Paytuvi-Gallart, A. et al.

Name: R-gene Database
Data_Type: R-gene sequences, allelic variants, resistance QTLs
Role_in_HOPPER: Web-queryable catalogue of characterized plant resistance-gene sequences.
Notes: Coverage of wild relatives and functional characterization remains incomplete.

Name: Expression Atlas
Role_in_HOPPER: Aggregates differential expression data across independently deposited studies.
Notes: Stress-condition metadata is only as consistent as submitting-lab annotation practice.

Reference_Publication.Title: Expression Atlas: gene and protein expression across multiple studies and organisms
Reference_Publication.Authors: Papatheodorou, I., Fonseca, N.A., Keays, M. et al.

Name: ProteomeXchange
Role_in_HOPPER: Consortium standardizing proteomics data submission and retrieval.
Notes: Primary repository partner is PRIDE.

Reference_Publication.Title: The ProteomeXchange consortium in 2020: enabling 'big data' approaches in proteomics
Reference_Publication.Authors: Deutsch, E.W., Bandeira, N., Sharma, V. et al.

Name: PRIDE
Role_in_HOPPER: Main ProteomeXchange repository for effector and host immune proteome data.
Notes: Metabolomic evidence remains comparatively underrepresented across this layer.

Reference_Publication.Title: The PRIDE database resources in 2022: a hub for mass spectrometry-based proteomics evidences
Reference_Publication.Authors: Perez-Riverol, Y., Bai, J., Bandla, C. et al.

Name: MaizeGDB
Data_Type: Genetic maps, genomic sequence, gene function
Role_in_HOPPER: Community-oriented informatics service for maize genetics and genomics.
Notes: Uses Plant Ontology and Gene Ontology for functional annotation; single-species scope.

Reference_Publication.Title: MaizeGDB 2018: the maize multi-genome genetics and genomics database
Reference_Publication.Authors: Portwood II, J.L., Woodhouse, M.R., Cannon, E.K. et al.

Name: Rice SNP-Seek
Role_in_HOPPER: Large-scale rice SNP repository built on the 3000 Rice Genomes Project.
Notes: At last check the IRRI-hosted service reported a temporary interruption; mirror sites were listed on its homepage. This is exactly the kind of availability change the Last_Checked field is meant to surface.

Reference_Publication.Title: Rice SNP-seek database update: new SNPs, indels, and queries
Reference_Publication.Authors: Mansueto, L., Fuentes, R.R., Borja, F.N. et al.

Name: SoyBase
Role_in_HOPPER: USDA-ARS repository for soybean genetics and genomics.
Notes: Links QTL and GWAS loci with standardized trait ontologies (SoyTO).

Reference_Publication.Title: A new decade and new data at SoyBase, the USDA-ARS soybean genetics and genomics database
Reference_Publication.Authors: Brown, A.V., Conners, S.I., Huang, W. et al.

Name: WheatIS
Role_in_HOPPER: Decentralized, internationally federated single-access point for wheat research data.
Notes: Deliberately federated design was intended to reduce single-region dependency.

Name: DroughtDB
Role_in_HOPPER: Expert-curated drought-responsive gene compilation with cross-species orthologs.
Notes: Curation concentrated in a small set of model/crop species.

Reference_Publication.Title: DroughtDB: an expert-curated compilation of plant drought stress genes and their homologs in nine species
Reference_Publication.Authors: Alter, S., Bader, K.C., Spannagl, M. et al.

Name: STIFDB2
Role_in_HOPPER: Catalogues stress-responsive transcription factors and predicted binding sites.
Notes: Taxonomic coverage confined almost entirely to two model/staple species.

Reference_Publication.Title: STIFDB2: an updated version of plant stress-responsive transcription factor database with additional stress signals, stress-responsive transcription factor binding sites and stress-responsive genes in Arabidopsis and rice
Reference_Publication.Authors: Naika, M., Shameer, K., Mathew, O.K., Gowda, R. & Sowdhamini, R.

Name: CyVerse
Role_in_HOPPER: Computational backbone for large-scale, high-throughput phenotyping projects.
Notes: Domain-general infrastructure; does not itself enforce stress-phenotype ontologies.

Reference_Publication.Title: The iPlant Collaborative: Cyberinfrastructure for Enabling Data to Discovery for the Life Sciences
Reference_Publication.Authors: Merchant, N., Lyons, E., Goff, S. et al.

Name: MGnify
Role_in_HOPPER: Secondary repository reconstructing metagenome-assembled genomes from public reads.
Notes: Soil assembly is more computationally intensive and slower to represent than host-associated microbiomes.

Reference_Publication.Title: MGnify: the microbiome sequence data analysis resource in 2023
Reference_Publication.Authors: Richardson, L., Allen, B., Baldi, G. et al.

Name: TerrestrialMetagenomeDB
Role_in_HOPPER: Standardizes and centralizes metadata scattered across SRA and MG-RAST.
Notes: Uses Environment Ontology (ENVO) text-mining for biome categorization; lacks physicochemical metadata.

Name: Plant Ontology
Role_in_HOPPER: Reference vocabulary HOPPER's ontology layer draws on for host anatomy/stage terms.
Notes: Adoption across pathogen, interaction, resistance and stress databases remains inconsistent.

Name: Planteome
Role_in_HOPPER: Broader knowledgebase federating Plant Ontology and related vocabularies.
Notes: Referenced here as the ontology-alignment inspiration for HOPPER's lightweight controlled vocabulary.
